scope: Paired location-allocation/source-order follow-up through 512 us, using the completed dynamic-junction runtime and unchanged pulses, strengths and reader. Numerical acceptance is separate from decodability.
purpose: Test whether waiting longer separates overlapping remote responses, motivated by increasing crossed-label contrast at the preceding 256-us endpoint. Fix 320/384/512-us observations before new response simulation.

reader.calibration: Unchanged three-strength polyline per arm, panel and timestep; all location/order combinations calibrated. Evaluation strengths never fit curves. The wire key timing now means source order.
reader.features: Every primary panel contains exactly 15 area-weighted voltages from unstimulated cells 2,3,5,6,7, in time-first order. All-cell comparators contain 21 values and never enter primary calibration.
reader.prediction: Project each observed vector onto each adjacent calibration segment with its coordinate clipped to [0,1]. For each task, take the minimum distance among curves with label 0 and label 1. Score=(distance_0-distance_1)/2; positive predicts 1, otherwise 0. Prediction accepts features only: no evaluation strength, labels, IDs or paired counterpart.
reader.margin: Resolved only when abs(score) exceeds the declared margin. Half the distance gap is in feature units and is 1-Lipschitz for fixed curves; it is not a biological noise model or a guarantee of correct generalization. Distances and inferred segment coordinates are retained.
reader.shuffles: Permute whole curve label pairs with the fixed seeds after fitting vertices. This preserves each physical response curve and the balanced label set. Duplicate permutations and the identity are retained; no significance claim.

primary: long512, matched calibration, dt=0.0625 us, 15 unstimulated-cell voltages at 320/384/512 us. Report location and SOURCE ORDER correct/resolved for all 16 joint evaluation cases, plus score and decision stability. Other panels and baseline-assisted transfer cannot replace it.
panel: Same 140 world identities, three calibration strengths and four evaluation strengths as the completed 256-us source-order assay, with every label combination and five arms. This paired follow-up reuses known cases; it is not a fresh holdout or independent biological replication.

contrast.definition: Label 1 minus label 0 area-weighted voltage, paired at fixed arm, other label and cue strength; 15 unstimulated-cell features in each predeclared observation panel
contrast.criteria_rationale: The absolute stability limit uses the original synthetic reader margin; the signal floor is twice that margin. The 10% limit requires small relative change as well. These are declared numerical diagnostics, not measured sensor precision or a continuum error bound.
contrast.stable_at_finest_steps: The 0.125-to-0.0625-us contrast change must satisfy BOTH the inherited 2-nV absolute and 10% relative limits. Separately report the signal floor and whether the 0.25-us contrast meets the same limits against 0.0625 us.
contrast.order_resolution: For each coordinate, a difference of two paired contrasts uses four inherited voltage comparison allowances: 4*atol + 2*rtol*(max_abs_early + max_abs_late). The two successive L2 changes must each exceed five times its L2 norm before interpreting their ratio as resolved first-order refinement. This comparison allowance is not a statistical noise estimate.

contrasts: For both labels, pair opposite labels at fixed arm, strength and other label. Report all pairs, including redundant single-task controls; they are not independent samples. Compare all three timestep contrasts using the inherited thresholds.
historical_reproduction: At each timestep, reproduce all 140 predecessor histories through 256 us and all three earlier feature/readout panels. Retain every prefix comparison and reject numerical differences outside unchanged tolerances. Record exact equality separately. New later responses cannot alter the earlier scientific results.
storage: Write complete 14-array state histories and sampled fields per world/window; retain only the current batch window and compact readout vectors. Compare CPU/L4 and changed-window replay by reading archive segments. Per-world inputs and completed windows remain durable on failure.
scope_exclusions: The only scientific design change is the longer horizon and one fixed later observation panel. Pulse timing, width, per-source dose, evaluation strengths, tissue, initial state, controls, reader, margin and numerical tolerances remain unchanged.
Preserve all 991 sources from the completed 512-us runtime, including the earlier assay and diagnostic sources. Add only this validation adapter, protocol and test suite; no production change.

The 320/384/512-us choice is informed by the preceding saved-data diagnosis, not by responses beyond 256 us. Reused cases and calibration strengths make this a paired follow-up, not a new blind validation cohort. No response simulation during development.
Retain the three old observation panels and reproduce the earlier scientific reports. The new primary is long512 only; earlier/all-cell/alternative-reader/reference-assisted views cannot replace it.
Allow 8192 steps per world instead of 4096 solely to accommodate the existing finest timestep through 512 us. Keep four-world batches, 1024-step windows and the existing per-window storage ceiling.
Scientific resolution, stability and transfer failures are recorded outcomes, not reasons to change thresholds or fail valid numerics. Three finite timesteps do not certify a continuum limit.

The native runtime qualification covers fixed synthetic junction cases at 1/0.5/0.25 us. The assay retains 0.25/0.125/0.0625-us refinement and CPU/L4 checks; no new native mixed-control correspondence claim.
Disconnected junctions leave other physical routes. External decoding is not a biological consumer, causal junction necessity, polycomputing, memory, reconstruction or heredity.
Reference-assisted transfer supplies target-timestep no-cue information. Its success is not primary success or transfer without that information.
Equal world-step budgets across all five arms; record actual per-arm timings and both GPU-busy and measured SM-active with coverage. No utilization gate, throughput result or Jupiter scaling claim.
No automatic follow-up, changes to archived evidence, or extension beyond the qualified 512-us horizon.

cue_timing.selection: One pulse per source; timing/order 0 assigns source 1 early and source 4 late, order 1 reverses this. No pulse-time search.
cue_timing.source_allocation: Each source retains amplitude * its 75/25 location share * minimum source membrane area integrated over 8 us. Order-only uses 50/50; no-cue uses zero. Compare dose with the common-pulse encoding at the SAME new strength.
cue_timing.comparison_panels: short64 precedes the second pulse and middle128 straddles it. They are descriptive only; long256 follows both pulses.

replay.purpose: Resume before the second source onset at 104 us; cross its on/off events at 104/112 us using 257-step windows, plus reorder and partition four calibration worlds.

task_meanings.location: 0: source 1 receives 75% of dose, source 4 receives 25%; 1: reverse allocation.
task_meanings.timing: Internal reader key for source_order: 0 = source 1 early and source 4 late; 1 = source 4 early and source 1 late. This is NOT the preceding common early/late cue task.
task_meanings.timing_only: Internal arm key for order-only: 50/50 source doses with the same opposite pulse orders.

baseline_reference: Report all nine source/target timestep combinations for long512 primary voltages using the unchanged no-cue reference algorithm. Verify matched score/distance/decision invariance. Target-timestep control information is supplied and cannot replace the primary result.
